tools.name: test_payram_connection
tools.title: Test Payram Connectivity
tools.description: Checks the /api/v1/payment endpoint on a Payram server using baseUrl and apiKey. If they are not provided, returns a .env template you can add to your workspace.

baseUrl.description: The base URL of your Payram server (e.g., https://your-server.example). If not provided, uses PAYRAM_BASE_URL from environment.

apiKey.description: Your Payram API key from the dashboard. If not provided, uses PAYRAM_API_KEY from environment.

tools.name: payram_doctor
tools.title: Diagnose a PayRam setup (one call)
tools.description: Staged, read-only health diagnosis: server reachability -> merchant API key -> admin JWT -> payment readiness (wallets + listener workers). Returns ranked likely causes with exact fix commands for the first failing stage. Run this FIRST when anything PayRam-related fails.

baseUrl.description: PayRam server base URL. Defaults to PAYRAM_BASE_URL. The installer publishes on port 80 (http://localhost), not :8080.

apiKey.description: Merchant API key (per-project). Defaults to PAYRAM_API_KEY. Obtain headlessly: ./setup_payram_agents.sh ensure-api-key

failedStage.description: First failing stage: reachability | api-key | jwt | readiness; null when healthy

fix.description: The exact command or action that resolves it

likelyCauses.description: Ranked causes for the first failing stage

tools.name: generate_topup_integration_snippet
tools.title: Generate top-up wallet integration
tools.description: For EXISTING apps: emits the recommended top-up wallet integration — ledger schema + cumulative-credit webhook handler + atomic invoice-settle function. Credits crypto payments to a user's balance first, then debits invoices from it, so over/under/late/duplicate payments become balance states, not payment exceptions. Pair with the payram-topup-wallet-integration skill. (New store with no users? Use the checkout/plugin path instead.)

part.description: Which piece to emit: 'schema' (ledger DDL), 'webhook' (cumulative-credit handler), 'settle' (atomic invoice debit), or 'all'.

framework.description: Server framework for the webhook handler + settle function.

tools.name: lookup_payment
tools.title: Lookup Payment
tools.description: Look up payments by transaction hash, email, reference ID, customer ID, or invoice ID. Returns up to 5 matching payments with full details.

query.description: Search query: transaction hash, email address, reference ID (UUID), customer ID, or invoice ID. The backend auto-detects the query type.

externalPlatformId.description: Optional. Auto-discovered from your account if omitted.

tools.name: search_payments
tools.title: Search Payments
tools.description: Search and filter payments with full control over status, network, currency, dates, webhook status, and pagination. Returns a paginated list of matching payments.

externalPlatformId.description: Optional. Auto-discovered from your account if omitted.

query.description: Free-text search: tx hash, email, reference ID, customer ID, or invoice ID.

network.description: Filter by blockchain network (e.g. BTC, ETH, TRX, BASE, POLYGON).

currency.description: Filter by currency code (e.g. USDC, USDT, BTC, ETH, TRX, CBBTC).

sortBy.description: Sort field. Valid: created_at, updated_at, payment_status, currency, network, block_id, from_address, to_address, invoice_id, reference_id, customer_id, email, created_by.

limit.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to 50.

tools.name: get_unswept_balances
tools.title: Get Unswept Balances
tools.description: Returns unswept (unsettled) balances across all wallets, broken down by blockchain and currency. Shows sweep readiness per entry (sweep, sweep_in_progress, sweep_not_allowed, no_balance) AND why stuck funds are stuck: lastSweepError (e.g. HOT_WALLET_LOW_GAS with the hot-wallet address to fund), pending SCW deployment, or missing cold wallet. Use this to answer "where is my money / why has it not swept".

tools.name: get_daily_volume
tools.title: Get Daily Volume
tools.description: Returns the total payment volume for a given date, with breakdowns by network and currency. Only counts FILLED (completed) payments. Defaults to today if no date is specified.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today (UTC).

externalPlatformId.description: Optional. Auto-discovered from your account if omitted.

tools.name: list_currencies
tools.title: List Supported Currencies
tools.description: Lists every blockchain currency PayRam supports on this node (chain code, network, currency code). Public endpoint — works with only PAYRAM_BASE_URL set, no API key or JWT required. Use this to discover valid blockchainCode/currencyCode values before creating payments or payouts.

tools.name: list_recipients
tools.title: List Payout Recipients
tools.description: Lists saved withdrawal recipients (payout beneficiaries). Use this to find a recipient ID for the 3-step payout flow, or to check whether a beneficiary is already OTP-verified (status "active") before creating a payout.

tools.name: create_payment_link
tools.title: Create Payment Link
tools.description: Creates a PayRam checkout (payment) link and returns the hosted URL plus a reference_id. Authenticates with the Merchant API-Key (set PAYRAM_API_KEY). This WRITES — it creates a real payment request. The customer chooses the chain/currency on the hosted checkout. Poll status later with lookup_payment (or GET /api/v1/payment/reference/{reference_id}).

customerID.description: Your internal customer identifier (sent as customerID, required)

customerEmail.description: Customer email (required — the backend validates it as a non-empty email)

tools.name: check_node_sync
tools.title: Check Node Sync
tools.description: Per-chain node health verdict: healthy / lagging / unreachable / listener-down. Computes how old each RPC node’s last block is — any non-BTC chain older than 10 minutes (BTC: 90 minutes, since BTC blocks every ~10m) is flagged as lagging or not syncing. Also checks the chain’s listener worker. When something is wrong it names the exact remediation (usually restart_payram_worker). Read-only — run this first; restart second; re-run this ~60s after a restart to confirm recovery.

tools.name: restart_payram_worker
tools.title: Restart PayRam Worker
tools.description: REMEDIATION ACTION (write): restarts a blockchain listener worker via supervisor — the minimal fix when check_node_sync reports a chain as lagging or listener-down. Workflow: run check_node_sync first → restart the named worker → wait ~60s → run check_node_sync again to confirm recovery. A restart does NOT fix an unreachable RPC (fix the RPC config in the dashboard instead). Requires admin JWT with write_system_settings.

worker.description: Worker to restart: a chain code ('BASE', 'ETH', 'BTC', 'TRX', 'POLYGON' → restarts that chain's listener) or a full worker name ('base-listener'). Omit when using all=true.

all.description: Restart ALL workers. Use only when multiple chains are unhealthy.

tools.name: check_payment_readiness
tools.title: Check Payment Readiness
tools.description: Diagnoses what is NOT yet set up to accept payments, per blockchain: missing deposit wallet, chain/currency not enabled for the project, or a stopped listener worker. Read-only — reports gaps and points to the CLI for wallet setup; it does not create wallets itself.

externalPlatformId.description: Project/platform ID to check currency enablement for (auto-resolved if omitted)
